claims.claim_text: Substantial doubt exists about Hyzon's ability to continue as a going concern. FY2023 net loss $184M, FY2023 cash $112.3M; by Q3 2024 cash dropped to $30.4M and management states it is 'continuing to evaluate the need to pursue bankruptcy protection or other in-court relief.' Filings index also contains a Form 25 (delisting, 2025-03-03) and Form 15-12G (deregistration, 2025-03-13/28).
claims.subject: Hyzon Motors Inc.
claims.predicate: is in late-stage distress with explicit bankruptcy contingency language
claims.object_value: going-concern + bankruptcy contingency; cash $30.4M (Q3-2024); delisting filed 2025-03
claims.source_quote: As of September 30, 2024, we had $30.4 million in unrestricted cash... We are also continuing to evaluate the need to pursue bankruptcy protection or other in-court relief if our financing efforts or other strategic alternatives are not successful.

claims.claim_text: Hyzon recognized only $0.3M of FCEV revenue in the U.S. for FY2023 (one vehicle) and $134K Q3 2024 / $10.4M 9M-2024. Cumulative deliveries are tiny vs the heavy-duty / Class-8 / refuse-truck market opportunity claimed. Company also still registers as a vehicle manufacturer.

The 10-K and 10-Q do NOT disclose any named binding hyperscaler / heavy-industry / utility customer offtake.

claims.claim_text: Hyzon settled an SEC enforcement action with a $25.0M civil penalty (final judgment entered Jan 16, 2024) for materially false statements about customer contracts, vehicle orders, and sales/earnings projections — confirmed prior-restatement / fraud disclosure pattern, plus continuing securities class action and derivative litigation.
